title: Cape Canaveral as cover for non-space projects
place_text: Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida

tellings.quote: If you put project X on Cape Canaveral Air Force Station they can always say oh well it's just related to the space program.

plain: Secret projects that have nothing to do with space can be hidden at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida, because anything there can be explained away as part of the space program. That is what Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor who worked there from about 1989 to 1999, tells Michels: "If you put project X on Cape Canaveral Air Force Station they can always say oh well it's just related to the space program." If true, it would make the base a natural home for the kind of hidden work he says he glimpsed.
